317-1475-6495.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional modified creature with power 1 or greater.
317-1475-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing another modified creature with power one or greater.
When the creature dies, Mazirek and One with the Kami triggers.
Resolve the One with the Kami trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Spirit creature tokens equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Resolve the Mazirek trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Repeat.
317-1475-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

2511-3263-6871--211.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the earthbend creature.
2511-3263-6871--211.description:
Cast the earthbend creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the earthbent creature.
When the creature dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur.
Repeat from step 3.
2511-3263-6871--211.notes: Depending on the earthbend creature used, you may receive additional results. There may also be needed prerequisites that are specific for each card (such as Bumi, King of Three Trials which requires a Lesson in your graveyard).

2292-4452-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
2292-4452-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat from step 3.

4419-4694-6797-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
4419-4694-6797-7306.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Renata.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing it to become a Spirit artifact creature in addition to its other types until end of turn.
Repeat from step 1.

Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.

Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.

240-969-5470-6495.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Repeat from step 2.

Resolve the Evereth ability.

6495-7388--5.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Zulaport Cutthroat and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

Activate Dark Sphere by sacrificing it.
Yomiji triggers due to Leyline of Singularity, returning Dark Sphere from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Dark Sphere's ability.
Cast Dark Sphere by paying {0}.
Repeat.

When the creature dies as a Human due to Arcane Adaptation, Xathrid Necromancer triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

Activate Fanatic of Rhonas by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Fanatic of Rhonas from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Fanatic of Rhonas by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token and a creature token.
Repeat.

1618-2440-3992-4485.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Docent of Perfection // Final Iteration
1618-2440-3992-4485.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Cyclical Evolution.
Cyclical Evolution triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Docent of Perfection // Final Iteration triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Cyclical Evolution.
Repeat.
1618-2440-3992-4485.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Docent of Perfection // Final Iteration. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

703-1603-7149.description:
Cast Evil Twin by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Put Evil Twin into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Evil Twin dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a land named Moon. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Astral Dragon, gaining its abilities.
When Evil Twin enters, it triggers, creating two token copies of itself, thus creating two copies of Moon with Astral Dragon's abilities, that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to its other types.
Put all but one of the Evil Twins into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Evil Twin tokens each trigger. Resolve a trigger, creating two token copies of itself, thus creating two copies of Moon with Astral Dragon's abilities, that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 5.
703-1603-7149.notes: The additional triggers can copy whatever noncreature permanent(s) you desire.

567-2308-4050-4871.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain any amount of life.
567-2308-4050-4871.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
When the Fungus Beast enters, Soul's Attendant triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {1}.
When the Fungus Beast dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Soul's Attendant trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

1765-2034-5972.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
1765-2034-5972.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Chishiro triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

3532-3536-5078-6769.easyPrerequisites: There are at least two counters on creatures you control.
3532-3536-5078-6769.description:
Declare Cheering Fanatic as an attacker. When it triggers, choose to name "Sensei's Divining Top".
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Diving Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters the battlefield, Surge Conductor triggers, putting a counter on a creature you control that already has a counter on it.
Repeat from step 2

3490-4050-5070-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4050-5070-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Angelic Chorus triggers, causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Spider-Man trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

132-198-3750.description:
Activate Myr Welder using Empowered Autogenerator's ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding {R} for each charge counter on it.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.
132-198-3750.notes: You can start the combo with fewer charge counters on Myr Welder but will need additional mana to compensate.

339-677-5256-5295.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

372-1031-2955.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Justiciar's Portal exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-1031-2955.description:
Cast Justiciar's Portal by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Invasion of Arcavios and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Invasion of Arcavios trigger.
Resolve the Invasion of Arcavios trigger, returning Justiciar's Portal from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Justiciar's Portal.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Invasion of Arcavios and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

803-3767-3918-5527.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Clues.
803-3767-3918-5527.description:
Activate Trazyn using Five Hundred Year Diary's ability by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

325-4067-5796-6282.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You have at least one card in hand.
325-4067-5796-6282.notablePrerequisites: You have at least eight permanent cards in your graveyard.
325-4067-5796-6282.description:
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card.
Toluz's second ability triggers, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Starving Revenant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability.
Repeat.

1912-3719-4865-5326.notablePrerequisites: Vesuvan Shapeshifter has a power of at least 2.
1912-3719-4865-5326.description:
Cast The Master by paying {U}{B}.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Vesuvan Shapeshifter and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Vesuvan Shapeshifter from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Vesuvan Shapeshifter to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Vesuvan Shapeshifter enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Vesuvan Shapeshifter by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

3542-5921.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}.
3542-5921.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
Cast Palinchron by paying {5}{U}{U}.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Holding priority, activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
Resolve the second Palinchron trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Palinchron by paying {2}{U}{U}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2167-2692-5626-5721.description:
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing a land, adding one mana of any color that land could produce.
Repeat step 1 until you have at least {4}{B}{G} available and/or you control no other mana-producing lands.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Felidar Retreat triggers that many times, creating that many creature tokens.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}, sacrificing a creature and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Aftermath Analyst enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

Activate Yurlok of Scorch Thrash using Farmstead Gleaner's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Move to your next step or phase, causing each player to lose life equal to the amount of unspent mana in their mana pool.

3858-5452.description: At the beginning of your upkeep, Mayael's Aria triggers, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control, gain 10 life and win the game.

1416-1506-2178.notablePrerequisites:
All Equipments and/or Auras attached to the same creature.
That creature does not have summoning sickness.
1416-1506-2178.description:
Activate the creature by tapping it, dealing damage to an opponent's creature.
The opponent's creature dies due to deathtouch, triggering the second ability granted by Thornbite Staff, untapping your creature.
Repeat until all opponents' creatures die.
Repeat each time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

917-4277.notablePrerequisites: You have no cards in hand.
917-4277.description:
Activate Idle Thoughts by paying {2}, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Cadaverous Bloom by exiling a card from your hand, adding {B}{B} or {G}{G}.
Repeat.

1295-1578-2713-4621.description:
Cast Manamorphose by paying {1}{R/G}.
Holding priority, activate Izzet Guildmage by paying {U}, copying Manamorphose.
Resolve the Manamorphose copy, adding two mana of any color and drawing a card.
Repeat until you have one card remaining in your library.
Resolve the original Manamorphose, adding {U}{U} and drawing a card.
Cast Thassa's Oracle by paying {U}{U}.
Thassa's Oracle enters the battlefield, causing you to win the game.
